name: pd_dev_start
description: Start the Pragma dev app as a managed background process. mode 'app' (default) runs `npm run dev:app` — the project's canonical launcher: starts Vite on :1420 if free, runs the app via `cargo run`, and only relaunches on the code-23 reload signal (never hot-restarts on Rust edits). mode 'tauri' runs `npm run tauri` (full Tauri dev with auto-reload — mind that it restarts on Rust edits). mode 'vite' runs `npm run dev` (frontend-only). Streams logs into a ring buffer and tracks compile state. You cannot see the app window — verify via pd_dev_status / pd_dev_logs. Idempotent (alreadyRunning). Only one instance can run the dev app; if the user's main app was itself launched via dev:app, a second instance connects to the same Vite and both share the DB — prefer pd_reload_app when Rust changes must land in the running app.

dir.description: Repo directory (defaults to the session working directory)

name: pd_dev_status
description: Report the managed dev server state: running?, mode, pid, directory, start time, parsed state (starting/compiling/running/error/exited), detected Vite port, error/warning counts, and log-line count.

name: pd_dev_logs
description: Return recent dev server log lines from the ring buffer. filter: 'all' (default), 'errors', 'warnings', or 'vite' (Vite-ready/built/port lines). Use this to inspect compile errors and confirm the build state — the logs are your eyes on the dev build.

name: pd_dev_stop
description: Stop the managed dev server (kills its process group). Idempotent — reports alreadyStopped if nothing is running.

name: pd_check
description: Run the frontend typecheck (`npm run check` — svelte-kit sync + svelte-check) and return parsed errors/warnings (file, line, col, message), a summary, and a raw tail. Fast feedback for Svelte/TS edits. Long-running; honor timeoutSecs.

dir.description: Repo directory (defaults to the session working directory)

name: pd_cargo_check
description: Run `cargo check --message-format=json` in src-tauri and return a clean, grouped list of Rust errors and warnings (file:line:col, code, message) — no full warning wall — plus a raw tail. Much better signal than a raw run_command grep. Generous default timeout (600s) for cold builds.

dir.description: Repo directory containing src-tauri (defaults to the session working directory)

name: pd_test
description: Run the frontend test suite (`npm run test` — vitest run) and return the pass/fail summary plus any failed test names and a raw tail.

dir.description: Repo directory (defaults to the session working directory)

name: pd_cargo_test
description: Run `cargo test` in src-tauri and return the test-result summary, the list of failed test names, failure detail text, and a raw tail. Generous default timeout (900s) because Rust tests compile first.

dir.description: Repo directory containing src-tauri (defaults to the session working directory)

name: pd_reload_app
description: Rebuild the Pragma backend and relaunch the app with the new Rust code. Runs `cargo build --manifest-path <dir>/src-tauri/Cargo.toml` (falls back to a root Cargo.toml); on SUCCESS it requests an app relaunch (exit code 23 — the dev:app launcher rebuilds and restarts; in other launchers the app exits cleanly). A failed build never triggers a restart; the error tail is returned instead. This ends the current run, so call it LAST, after your Rust edits are complete and verified — never for frontend-only or plugin-only changes (those hot-reload automatically).

dir.description: Repo directory containing src-tauri (defaults to the session working directory)

timeoutSecs.description: Timeout in seconds, default 900 (cold builds are slow)

name: pd_verify_command
description: Verify a Tauri command is fully wired per pragma conventions: implementation under src-tauri/src/commands/, `pub mod` in commands/mod.rs, registration in lib.rs generate_handler!, and a wrapper in src/lib/tauri.ts. Returns per-check pass/fail with file:line evidence. Call this after adding a Tauri command.

dir.description: Repo directory (defaults to the session working directory)

name: pd_verify_tool
description: Verify a tool is fully wired per pragma conventions: a ToolDefinition in tools/definitions.rs (core_tools or skill_tools), a dispatch arm in tools/mod.rs (or agentic.rs for inline/session-aware tools), and its SAFE_TOOLS/approval classification in src/stores/chat.svelte.ts (informational). Returns per-check pass/fail with file:line evidence.

dir.description: Repo directory (defaults to the session working directory)

name: pd_todo
description: Scan the pragma source (src/ and src-tauri/src/) for TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX markers and return them grouped by file with a count and the matching lines. Useful when scoping work or auditing tech debt.

dir.description: Repo directory (defaults to the session working directory)

name: pd_arch
description: Dump the current architecture surface of the repo: all registered Tauri commands (parsed from lib.rs generate_handler!), all core tool names (from tools/definitions.rs), frontend components, and routes. Use when you need the authoritative list of commands/tools/components rather than trusting memory.

dir.description: Repo directory (defaults to the session working directory)
